23261.label: Matthew 1:1
23261.text: The book of the history of Jesus Christ, son of David, son of Abraham:

23262.label: Matthew 1:2
23262.text: Abraham became father to Isaac; Isaac became father to Jacob; Jacob became father to Judah and his brothers;

23263.label: Matthew 1:3
23263.text: Judah became father to Peʹrez and Zeʹrah by Taʹmar;Peʹrez became father to Hezʹron; Hezʹron became father to Ram;

23264.label: Matthew 1:4
23264.text: Ram became father to Am·minʹa·dab;Am·minʹa·dab became father to Nahʹshon; Nahʹshon became father to Salʹmon;

23265.label: Matthew 1:5
23265.text: Salʹmon became father to Boʹaz by Raʹhab; Boʹaz became father to Oʹbed by Ruth; Oʹbed became father to Jesʹse;

23266.label: Matthew 1:6
23266.text: Jesʹse became father to David the king. David became father to Solʹo·mon by the wife of U·riʹah;

23267.label: Matthew 1:7
23267.text: Solʹo·mon became father to Re·ho·boʹam; Re·ho·boʹam became father to A·biʹjah;A·biʹjah became father to Aʹsa;

23268.label: Matthew 1:8
23268.text: Aʹsa became father to Je·hoshʹa·phat; Je·hoshʹa·phat became father to Je·hoʹram; Je·hoʹram became father to Uz·ziʹah;

23269.label: Matthew 1:9
23269.text: Uz·ziʹah became father to Joʹtham; Joʹtham became father to Aʹhaz; Aʹhaz became father to Hez·e·kiʹah;

23270.label: Matthew 1:10
23270.text: Hez·e·kiʹah became father to Ma·nasʹseh; Ma·nasʹseh became father to Aʹmon; Aʹmon became father to Jo·siʹah;

23271.label: Matthew 1:11
23271.text: Jo·siʹah became father to Jec·o·niʹah and to his brothers at the time of the deportation to Babylon.

23272.label: Matthew 1:12
23272.text: After the deportation to Babylon, Jec·o·niʹah became father to She·alʹti·el;She·alʹti·el became father to Ze·rubʹba·bel;

23273.label: Matthew 1:13
23273.text: Ze·rubʹba·bel became father to A·biʹud;A·biʹud became father to E·liʹa·kim;E·liʹa·kim became father to Aʹzor;

23274.label: Matthew 1:14
23274.text: Aʹzor became father to Zaʹdok;Zaʹdok became father to Aʹchim;Aʹchim became father to E·liʹud;

23275.label: Matthew 1:15
23275.text: E·liʹud became father to El·e·aʹzar;El·e·aʹzar became father to Matʹthan;Matʹthan became father to Jacob;

23276.label: Matthew 1:16
23276.text: Jacob became father to Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, who is called Christ.

23277.label: Matthew 1:17
23277.text: All the generations, then, from Abraham until David were 14 generations; from David until the deportation to Babylon, 14 generations; from the deportation to Babylon until the Christ, 14 generations.

23278.label: Matthew 1:18
23278.text: But this is how the birth of Jesus Christ took place. During the time his mother Mary was promised in marriage to Joseph, she was found to be pregnant by holy spirit before they were united.

23279.label: Matthew 1:19
23279.text: However, because her husband Joseph was righteous and did not want to make her a public spectacle, he intended to divorce her secretly.

23280.label: Matthew 1:20
23280.text: But after he had thought these things over, look! Jehovah’s angel appeared to him in a dream, saying: “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take your wife Mary home, for what has been conceived in her is by holy spirit.

23281.label: Matthew 1:21
23281.text: She will give birth to a son, and you are to name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.”

23282.label: Matthew 1:22
23282.text: All of this actually came about to fulfill what was spoken by Jehovah through his prophet, saying:

23283.label: Matthew 1:23
23283.text: “Look! The virgin will become pregnant and will give birth to a son, and they will name him Im·manʹu·el,” which means, when translated, “With Us Is God.”

23284.label: Matthew 1:24
23284.text: Then Joseph woke up from his sleep and did as the angel of Jehovah had directed him, and he took his wife home.

23285.label: Matthew 1:25
23285.text: But he did not have sexual relations with her until she gave birth to a son, and he named him Jesus.

23286.label: Matthew 2:1
23286.text: After Jesus had been born in Bethʹle·hem of Ju·deʹa in the days of Herod the king, look! astrologers from the East came to Jerusalem,

23287.label: Matthew 2:2
23287.text: saying: “Where is the one born king of the Jews? For we saw his star when we were in the East, and we have come to do obeisance to him.”

23288.label: Matthew 2:3
23288.text: At hearing this, King Herod was agitated, and all Jerusalem with him.

23289.label: Matthew 2:4
23289.text: On gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born.

23290.label: Matthew 2:5
23290.text: They said to him: “In Bethʹle·hem of Ju·deʹa, for this is how it has been written through the prophet:

23291.label: Matthew 2:6
23291.text: ‘And you, O Bethʹle·hem of the land of Judah, are by no means the most insignificant city among the governors of Judah, for out of you will come a governing one, who will shepherd my people Israel.’”

23292.label: Matthew 2:7
23292.text: Then Herod secretly summoned the astrologers and carefully ascertained from them the time of the star’s appearing.

23293.label: Matthew 2:8
23293.text: When sending them to Bethʹle·hem, he said: “Go make a careful search for the young child, and when you have found him, report back to me so that I too may go and do obeisance to him.”

23294.label: Matthew 2:9
23294.text: After they had heard the king, they went their way, and look! the star they had seen when they were in the East went ahead of them until it came to a stop above where the young child was.

23295.label: Matthew 2:10
23295.text: On seeing the star, they rejoiced with great joy.

23296.label: Matthew 2:11
23296.text: And when they went into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and falling down, they did obeisance to him. They also opened their treasures and presented him with gifts—gold and frankincense and myrrh.

23297.label: Matthew 2:12
23297.text: However, because they were given divine warning in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed for their country by another way.

23298.label: Matthew 2:13
23298.text: After they had departed, look! Jehovah’s angel appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying: “Get up, take the young child and his mother and flee to Egypt, and stay there until I give you word, for Herod is about to search for the young child to kill him.”

23299.label: Matthew 2:14
23299.text: So Joseph got up and by night took along the young child and the child’s mother and went into Egypt.

23300.label: Matthew 2:15
23300.text: He stayed there until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what was spoken by Jehovah through his prophet, saying: “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

23301.label: Matthew 2:16
23301.text: Then Herod, seeing that he had been outwitted by the astrologers, flew into a great rage, and he sent out and had all the boys in Bethʹle·hem and in all its districts killed, from two years of age and under, according to the time that he had carefully ascertained from the astrologers.

23302.label: Matthew 2:17
23302.text: Then was fulfilled what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet, who said:

23303.label: Matthew 2:18
23303.text: “A voice was heard in Raʹmah, weeping and much wailing. It was Rachel weeping for her children, and she was unwilling to take comfort, because they are no more.”

23304.label: Matthew 2:19
23304.text: When Herod had died, look! Jehovah’s angel appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt

23305.label: Matthew 2:20
23305.text: and said: “Get up, take the young child and his mother and go into the land of Israel, for those who were seeking the life of the young child are dead.”

23306.label: Matthew 2:21
23306.text: So he got up and took the young child and the child’s mother and entered into the land of Israel.

23307.label: Matthew 2:22
23307.text: But hearing that Ar·che·laʹus ruled Ju·deʹa instead of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Moreover, being given divine warning in a dream, he withdrew into the territory of Galʹi·lee.

23308.label: Matthew 2:23
23308.text: And he came and settled in a city named Nazʹa·reth, in order to fulfill what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Naz·a·reneʹ.”

23309.label: Matthew 3:1
23309.text: In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Ju·deʹa,

23310.label: Matthew 3:2
23310.text: saying: “Repent, for the Kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.”

23311.label: Matthew 3:3
23311.text: This, in fact, is the one spoken of through Isaiah the prophet in these words: “A voice of one calling out in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of Jehovah! Make his roads straight.’”

23312.label: Matthew 3:4
23312.text: Now John was clothed with camel’s hair and had a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

23313.label: Matthew 3:5
23313.text: Then the people of Jerusalem and all Ju·deʹa and all the country around the Jordan were going out to him,

23314.label: Matthew 3:6
23314.text: and they were baptized by him in the Jordan River, openly confessing their sins.

23315.label: Matthew 3:7
23315.text: When he caught sight of many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to the baptism, he said to them: “You offspring of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

23316.label: Matthew 3:8
23316.text: Therefore, produce fruit that befits repentance.

23317.label: Matthew 3:9
23317.text: Do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I say to you that God is able to raise up children for Abraham from these stones.

23318.label: Matthew 3:10
23318.text: The ax is already lying at the root of the trees. Every tree, then, that does not produce fine fruit is to be cut down and thrown into the fire.

23319.label: Matthew 3:11
23319.text: I, for my part, baptize you with water because of your repentance, but the one coming after me is stronger than I am, whose sandals I am not worthy to take off. That one will baptize you with holy spirit and with fire.

23320.label: Matthew 3:12
23320.text: His winnowing shovel is in his hand, and he will clean up his threshing floor completely and will gather his wheat into the storehouse, but the chaff he will burn up with fire that cannot be put out.”

23321.label: Matthew 3:13
23321.text: Then Jesus came from Galʹi·lee to the Jordan to John, in order to be baptized by him.

23322.label: Matthew 3:14
23322.text: But the latter tried to prevent him, saying: “I am the one who needs to be baptized by you, and are you coming to me?”

23323.label: Matthew 3:15
23323.text: Jesus replied to him: “Let it be this time, for in that way it is suitable for us to carry out all that is righteous.” Then he quit preventing him.

23324.label: Matthew 3:16
23324.text: After being baptized, Jesus immediately came up from the water; and look! the heavens were opened up, and he saw God’s spirit descending like a dove and coming upon him.

23325.label: Matthew 3:17
23325.text: Look! Also, a voice from the heavens said: “This is my Son, the beloved, whom I have approved.”

23326.label: Matthew 4:1
23326.text: Then Jesus was led by the spirit up into the wilderness to be tempted by the Devil.

23327.label: Matthew 4:2
23327.text: After he had fasted for 40 days and 40 nights, he felt hungry.

23328.label: Matthew 4:3
23328.text: And the Tempter approached and said to him: “If you are a son of God, tell these stones to become loaves of bread.”

23329.label: Matthew 4:4
23329.text: But he answered: “It is written: ‘Man must live, not on bread alone, but on every word that comes from Jehovah’s mouth.’”

23330.label: Matthew 4:5
23330.text: Then the Devil took him along into the holy city, and he stationed him on the battlement of the temple

23331.label: Matthew 4:6
23331.text: and said to him: “If you are a son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written: ‘He will give his angels a command concerning you,’ and, ‘They will carry you on their hands, so that you may not strike your foot against a stone.’”

23332.label: Matthew 4:7
23332.text: Jesus said to him: “Again it is written: ‘You must not put Jehovah your God to the test.’”

23333.label: Matthew 4:8
23333.text: Again the Devil took him along to an unusually high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

23334.label: Matthew 4:9
23334.text: And he said to him: “All these things I will give you if you fall down and do an act of worship to me.”

23335.label: Matthew 4:10
23335.text: Then Jesus said to him: “Go away, Satan! For it is written: ‘It is Jehovah your God you must worship, and it is to him alone you must render sacred service.’”

23336.label: Matthew 4:11
23336.text: Then the Devil left him, and look! angels came and began to minister to him.

23337.label: Matthew 4:12
23337.text: Now when he heard that John had been arrested, he withdrew into Galʹi·lee.

23338.label: Matthew 4:13
23338.text: Further, after leaving Nazʹa·reth, he came and took up residence in Ca·perʹna·um beside the sea in the districts of Zebʹu·lun and Naphʹta·li,

23339.label: Matthew 4:14
23339.text: so as to fulfill what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, who said:

23340.label: Matthew 4:15
23340.text: “O land of Zebʹu·lun and land of Naphʹta·li, along the road of the sea, on the other side of the Jordan, Galʹi·lee of the nations!

23341.label: Matthew 4:16
23341.text: The people sitting in darkness saw a great light, and as for those sitting in a region of deathly shadow, light rose on them.”

23342.label: Matthew 4:17
23342.text: From that time on, Jesus began preaching and saying: “Repent, for the Kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.”

23343.label: Matthew 4:18
23343.text: Walking alongside the Sea of Galʹi·lee, he saw two brothers, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

23344.label: Matthew 4:19
23344.text: And he said to them: “Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.”

23345.label: Matthew 4:20
23345.text: At once they abandoned their nets and followed him.

23346.label: Matthew 4:21
23346.text: Going on from there, he saw two others who were brothers, James the son of Zebʹe·dee and his brother John. They were in the boat with Zebʹe·dee their father, mending their nets, and he called them.

23347.label: Matthew 4:22
23347.text: At once they left the boat and their father and followed him.

23348.label: Matthew 4:23
23348.text: Then he went throughout the whole of Galʹi·lee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news of the Kingdom and curing every sort of disease and every sort of infirmity among the people.

23349.label: Matthew 4:24
23349.text: And the report about him spread throughout all Syria, and they brought him all those who were suffering with various diseases and torments, those who were demon-possessed and epileptic and paralyzed, and he cured them.

23350.label: Matthew 4:25
23350.text: Consequently, large crowds followed him from Galʹi·lee and De·capʹo·lis and Jerusalem and Ju·deʹa and from the other side of the Jordan.

23351.label: Matthew 5:1
23351.text: When he saw the crowds, he went up on the mountain; and after he sat down, his disciples came to him.

23352.label: Matthew 5:2
23352.text: Then he opened his mouth and began teaching them, saying:

23353.label: Matthew 5:3
23353.text: “Happy are those conscious of their spiritual need, since the Kingdom of the heavens belongs to them.

23354.label: Matthew 5:4
23354.text: “Happy are those who mourn, since they will be comforted.

23355.label: Matthew 5:5
23355.text: “Happy are the mild-tempered, since they will inherit the earth.

23356.label: Matthew 5:6
23356.text: “Happy are those hungering and thirsting for righteousness, since they will be filled.

23357.label: Matthew 5:7
23357.text: “Happy are the merciful, since they will be shown mercy.

23358.label: Matthew 5:8
23358.text: “Happy are the pure in heart, since they will see God.

23359.label: Matthew 5:9
23359.text: “Happy are the peacemakers, since they will be called sons of God.

23360.label: Matthew 5:10
23360.text: “Happy are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, since the Kingdom of the heavens belongs to them.

23361.label: Matthew 5:11
23361.text: “Happy are you when people reproach you and persecute you and lyingly say every sort of wicked thing against you for my sake.

23362.label: Matthew 5:12
23362.text: Rejoice and be overjoyed, since your reward is great in the heavens, for in that way they persecuted the prophets prior to you.

23363.label: Matthew 5:13
23363.text: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt loses its strength, how will its saltiness be restored? It is no longer usable for anything except to be thrown outside to be trampled on by men.

23364.label: Matthew 5:14
23364.text: “You are the light of the world. A city cannot be hid when located on a mountain.

23365.label: Matthew 5:15
23365.text: People light a lamp and set it, not under a basket, but on the lampstand, and it shines on all those in the house.

23366.label: Matthew 5:16
23366.text: Likewise, let your light shine before men, so that they may see your fine works and give glory to your Father who is in the heavens.

23367.label: Matthew 5:17
23367.text: “Do not think I came to destroy the Law or the Prophets. I came, not to destroy, but to fulfill.

23368.label: Matthew 5:18
23368.text: Truly I say to you that sooner would heaven and earth pass away than for one smallest letter or one stroke of a letter to pass away from the Law until all things take place.

23369.label: Matthew 5:19
23369.text: Whoever, therefore, breaks one of these least commandments and teaches others to do so will be called least in relation to the Kingdom of the heavens. But whoever does them and teaches them will be called great in relation to the Kingdom of the heavens.

23370.label: Matthew 5:20
23370.text: For I say to you that if your righteousness does not surpass that of the scribes and the Pharisees, you will by no means enter into the Kingdom of the heavens.

23371.label: Matthew 5:21
23371.text: “You heard that it was said to those of ancient times: ‘You must not murder, but whoever commits a murder will be accountable to the court of justice.’

23372.label: Matthew 5:22
23372.text: However, I say to you that everyone who continues wrathful with his brother will be accountable to the court of justice; and whoever addresses his brother with an unspeakable word of contempt will be accountable to the Supreme Court; whereas whoever says, ‘You despicable fool!’ will be liable to the fiery Ge·henʹna.

23373.label: Matthew 5:23
23373.text: “If, then, you are bringing your gift to the altar and there you remember that your brother has something against you,

23374.label: Matthew 5:24
23374.text: leave your gift there in front of the altar, and go away. First make your peace with your brother, and then come back and offer your gift.

23375.label: Matthew 5:25
23375.text: “Be quick to settle matters with your legal opponent, while you are with him on the way there, so that somehow the opponent may not turn you over to the judge, and the judge to the court attendant, and you get thrown into prison.

23376.label: Matthew 5:26
23376.text: I say to you for a fact, you will certainly not come out of there until you have paid over your last small coin.

23377.label: Matthew 5:27
23377.text: “You heard that it was said: ‘You must not commit adultery.’

23378.label: Matthew 5:28
23378.text: But I say to you that everyone who keeps on looking at a woman so as to have a passion for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

23379.label: Matthew 5:29
23379.text: If, now, your right eye is making you stumble, tear it out and throw it away from you. For it is better for you to lose one of your members than for your whole body to be pitched into Ge·henʹna.

23380.label: Matthew 5:30
23380.text: Also, if your right hand is making you stumble, cut it off and throw it away from you. For it is better for you to lose one of your members than for your whole body to land in Ge·henʹna.

23381.label: Matthew 5:31
23381.text: “Moreover, it was said: ‘Whoever divorces his wife, let him give her a certificate of divorce.’

23382.label: Matthew 5:32
23382.text: However, I say to you that everyone divorcing his wife, except on account of sexual immorality, makes her a subject for adultery, and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

23383.label: Matthew 5:33
23383.text: “Again you heard that it was said to those of ancient times: ‘You must not swear without performing, but you must pay your vows to Jehovah.’

23384.label: Matthew 5:34
23384.text: However, I say to you: Do not swear at all, neither by heaven, for it is God’s throne;

23385.label: Matthew 5:35
23385.text: nor by earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

23386.label: Matthew 5:36
23386.text: Do not swear by your head, since you cannot turn one hair white or black.

23387.label: Matthew 5:37
23387.text: Just let your word ‘Yes’ mean yes, your ‘No,’ no, for what goes beyond these is from the wicked one.

23388.label: Matthew 5:38
23388.text: “You heard that it was said: ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’

23389.label: Matthew 5:39
23389.text: However, I say to you: Do not resist the one who is wicked, but whoever slaps you on your right cheek, turn the other also to him.

23390.label: Matthew 5:40
23390.text: And if a person wants to take you to court and get possession of your inner garment, let him also have your outer garment;

23391.label: Matthew 5:41
23391.text: and if someone in authority compels you into service for a mile, go with him two miles.

23392.label: Matthew 5:42
23392.text: Give to the one asking you, and do not turn away from one who wants to borrow from you.

23393.label: Matthew 5:43
23393.text: “You heard that it was said: ‘You must love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

23394.label: Matthew 5:44
23394.text: However, I say to you: Continue to love your enemies and to pray for those who persecute you,

23395.label: Matthew 5:45
23395.text: so that you may prove yourselves sons of your Father who is in the heavens, since he makes his sun rise on both the wicked and the good and makes it rain on both the righteous and the unrighteous.

23396.label: Matthew 5:46
23396.text: For if you love those loving you, what reward do you have? Are not also the tax collectors doing the same thing?

23397.label: Matthew 5:47
23397.text: And if you greet your brothers only, what extraordinary thing are you doing? Are not also the people of the nations doing the same thing?

23398.label: Matthew 5:48
23398.text: You must accordingly be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.

23399.label: Matthew 6:1
23399.text: “Take care not to practice your righteousness in front of men to be noticed by them; otherwise you will have no reward with your Father who is in the heavens.

23400.label: Matthew 6:2
23400.text: So when you make gifts of mercy, do not blow a trumpet ahead of you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may be glorified by men. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.

23401.label: Matthew 6:3
23401.text: But you, when making gifts of mercy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,

23402.label: Matthew 6:4
23402.text: so that your gifts of mercy may be in secret. Then your Father who looks on in secret will repay you.

23403.label: Matthew 6:5
23403.text: “Also, when you pray, do not act like the hypocrites, for they like to pray standing in the synagogues and on the corners of the main streets to be seen by men. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.

23404.label: Matthew 6:6
23404.text: But when you pray, go into your private room and, after shutting your door, pray to your Father who is in secret. Then your Father who looks on in secret will repay you.

23405.label: Matthew 6:7
23405.text: When praying, do not say the same things over and over again as the people of the nations do, for they imagine they will get a hearing for their use of many words.

23406.label: Matthew 6:8
23406.text: So do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need even before you ask him.

23407.label: Matthew 6:9
23407.text: “You must pray, then, this way: “‘Our Father in the heavens, let your name be sanctified.

23408.label: Matthew 6:10
23408.text: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will take place, as in heaven, also on earth.

23409.label: Matthew 6:11
23409.text: Give us today our bread for this day;

23410.label: Matthew 6:12
23410.text: and forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

23411.label: Matthew 6:13
23411.text: And do not bring us into temptation, but deliver us from the wicked one.’

23412.label: Matthew 6:14
23412.text: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you;

23413.label: Matthew 6:15
23413.text: whereas if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

23414.label: Matthew 6:16
23414.text: “When you fast, stop becoming sad-faced like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces so they may appear to men to be fasting. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.

23415.label: Matthew 6:17
23415.text: But you, when fasting, put oil on your head and wash your face,

23416.label: Matthew 6:18
23416.text: so that you may not appear to be fasting to men but only to your Father who is in secret. Then your Father who looks on in secret will repay you.

23417.label: Matthew 6:19
23417.text: “Stop storing up for yourselves treasures on the earth, where moth and rust consume and where thieves break in and steal.

23418.label: Matthew 6:20
23418.text: Rather, store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consumes, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

23419.label: Matthew 6:21
23419.text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

23420.label: Matthew 6:22
23420.text: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If, then, your eye is focused, your whole body will be bright.

23421.label: Matthew 6:23
23421.text: But if your eye is envious, your whole body will be dark. If the light that is in you is really darkness, how great that darkness is!

23422.label: Matthew 6:24
23422.text: “No one can slave for two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will stick to the one and despise the other. You cannot slave for God and for Riches.

23423.label: Matthew 6:25
23423.text: “On this account I say to you: Stop being anxious about your lives as to what you will eat or what you will drink, or about your bodies as to what you will wear. Does not life mean more than food and the body than clothing?

23424.label: Matthew 6:26
23424.text: Observe intently the birds of heaven; they do not sow seed or reap or gather into storehouses, yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not worth more than they are?

23425.label: Matthew 6:27
23425.text: Who of you by being anxious can add one cubit to his life span?

23426.label: Matthew 6:28
23426.text: Also, why are you anxious about clothing? Take a lesson from the lilies of the field, how they grow; they do not toil, nor do they spin;

23427.label: Matthew 6:29
23427.text: but I tell you that not even Solʹo·mon in all his glory was arrayed as one of these.

23428.label: Matthew 6:30
23428.text: Now if this is how God clothes the vegetation of the field that is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will he not much rather clothe you, you with little faith?

23429.label: Matthew 6:31
23429.text: So never be anxious and say, ‘What are we to eat?’ or, ‘What are we to drink?’ or, ‘What are we to wear?’

23430.label: Matthew 6:32
23430.text: For all these are the things the nations are eagerly pursuing. Your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

23431.label: Matthew 6:33
23431.text: “Keep on, then, seeking first the Kingdom and his righteousness, and all these other things will be added to you.

23432.label: Matthew 6:34
23432.text: So never be anxious about the next day, for the next day will have its own anxieties. Each day has enough of its own troubles.

23433.label: Matthew 7:1
23433.text: “Stop judging that you may not be judged;

23434.label: Matthew 7:2
23434.text: for with the judgment you are judging, you will be judged, and with the measure that you are measuring out, they will measure out to you.

23435.label: Matthew 7:3
23435.text: Why, then, do you look at the straw in your brother’s eye but do not notice the rafter in your own eye?

23436.label: Matthew 7:4
23436.text: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Allow me to remove the straw from your eye,’ when look! a rafter is in your own eye?

23437.label: Matthew 7:5
23437.text: Hypocrite! First remove the rafter from your own eye, and then you will see clearly how to remove the straw from your brother’s eye.

23438.label: Matthew 7:6
23438.text: “Do not give what is holy to dogs nor throw your pearls before swine, so that they may never trample them under their feet and turn around and rip you open.

23439.label: Matthew 7:7
23439.text: “Keep on asking, and it will be given you; keep on seeking, and you will find; keep on knocking, and it will be opened to you;

23440.label: Matthew 7:8
23440.text: for everyone asking receives, and everyone seeking finds, and to everyone knocking, it will be opened.

23441.label: Matthew 7:9
23441.text: Indeed, which one of you, if his son asks for bread, will hand him a stone?

23442.label: Matthew 7:10
23442.text: Or if he asks for a fish, he will not hand him a serpent, will he?

23443.label: Matthew 7:11
23443.text: Therefore, if you, although being wicked, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more so will your Father who is in the heavens give good things to those asking him!

23444.label: Matthew 7:12
23444.text: “All things, therefore, that you want men to do to you, you also must do to them. This, in fact, is what the Law and the Prophets mean.

23445.label: Matthew 7:13
23445.text: “Go in through the narrow gate, because broad is the gate and spacious is the road leading off into destruction, and many are going in through it;

23446.label: Matthew 7:14
23446.text: whereas narrow is the gate and cramped the road leading off into life, and few are finding it.

23447.label: Matthew 7:15
23447.text: “Be on the watch for the false prophets who come to you in sheep’s covering, but inside they are ravenous wolves.

23448.label: Matthew 7:16
23448.text: By their fruits you will recognize them. Never do people gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles, do they?

23449.label: Matthew 7:17
23449.text: Likewise, every good tree produces fine fruit, but every rotten tree produces worthless fruit.

23450.label: Matthew 7:18
23450.text: A good tree cannot bear worthless fruit, nor can a rotten tree produce fine fruit.

23451.label: Matthew 7:19
23451.text: Every tree not producing fine fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

23452.label: Matthew 7:20
23452.text: Really, then, by their fruits you will recognize those men.

23453.label: Matthew 7:21
23453.text: “Not everyone saying to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of the heavens, but only the one doing the will of my Father who is in the heavens will.

23454.label: Matthew 7:22
23454.text: Many will say to me in that day: ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name, and expel demons in your name, and perform many powerful works in your name?’

23455.label: Matthew 7:23
23455.text: And then I will declare to them: ‘I never knew you! Get away from me, you workers of lawlessness!’

23456.label: Matthew 7:24
23456.text: “Therefore, everyone who hears these sayings of mine and does them will be like a discreet man who built his house on the rock.

23457.label: Matthew 7:25
23457.text: And the rain poured down and the floods came and the winds blew and lashed against that house, but it did not cave in, for it had been founded on the rock.

23458.label: Matthew 7:26
23458.text: Furthermore, everyone hearing these sayings of mine and not doing them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

23459.label: Matthew 7:27
23459.text: And the rain poured down and the floods came and the winds blew and struck against that house, and it caved in, and its collapse was great.”

23460.label: Matthew 7:28
23460.text: When Jesus finished these sayings, the effect was that the crowds were astounded at his way of teaching,

23461.label: Matthew 7:29
23461.text: for he was teaching them as a person having authority, and not as their scribes.

23462.label: Matthew 8:1
23462.text: After he came down from the mountain, large crowds followed him.

23463.label: Matthew 8:2
23463.text: And look! a leper came up and did obeisance to him, saying: “Lord, if you just want to, you can make me clean.”

23464.label: Matthew 8:3
23464.text: So stretching out his hand, he touched him, saying: “I want to! Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed away.

23465.label: Matthew 8:4
23465.text: Then Jesus said to him: “See that you tell no one, but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses appointed, for a witness to them.”

23466.label: Matthew 8:5
23466.text: When he entered Ca·perʹna·um, an army officer came to him, pleading with him

23467.label: Matthew 8:6
23467.text: and saying: “Sir, my servant is laid up in the house with paralysis, and he is suffering terribly.”

23468.label: Matthew 8:7
23468.text: He said to him: “When I get there, I will cure him.”

23469.label: Matthew 8:8
23469.text: The army officer replied: “Sir, I am not worthy to have you come under my roof, but just say the word and my servant will be healed.

23470.label: Matthew 8:9
23470.text: For I too am a man under authority, having soldiers under me, and I say to this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this!’ and he does it.”

23471.label: Matthew 8:10
23471.text: When Jesus heard that, he was amazed and said to those following him: “I tell you the truth, with no one in Israel have I found so great a faith.

23472.label: Matthew 8:11
23472.text: But I tell you that many from east and west will come and recline at the table with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the Kingdom of the heavens;

23473.label: Matthew 8:12
23473.text: whereas the sons of the Kingdom will be thrown into the darkness outside. There is where their weeping and the gnashing of their teeth will be.”

23474.label: Matthew 8:13
23474.text: Then Jesus said to the army officer: “Go. Just as you have shown faith, so let it come to pass for you.” And the servant was healed in that hour.

23475.label: Matthew 8:14
23475.text: And Jesus, on coming into Peter’s house, saw his mother-in-law lying down and sick with fever.

23476.label: Matthew 8:15
23476.text: So he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began ministering to him.

23477.label: Matthew 8:16
23477.text: But after it became evening, people brought him many demon-possessed ones; and he expelled the spirits with a word, and he cured all who were suffering,

23478.label: Matthew 8:17
23478.text: in order to fulfill what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet: “He himself took our sicknesses and carried our diseases.”

23479.label: Matthew 8:18
23479.text: When Jesus saw a crowd around him, he gave the command to depart for the other side.

23480.label: Matthew 8:19
23480.text: And a scribe came up and said to him: “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

23481.label: Matthew 8:20
23481.text: But Jesus said to him: “Foxes have dens and birds of heaven have nests, but the Son of man has nowhere to lay down his head.”

23482.label: Matthew 8:21
23482.text: Then another of the disciples said to him: “Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father.”

23483.label: Matthew 8:22
23483.text: Jesus said to him: “Keep following me, and let the dead bury their dead.”

23484.label: Matthew 8:23
23484.text: And when he went aboard a boat, his disciples followed him.

23485.label: Matthew 8:24
23485.text: Now look! a great storm arose on the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves; but he was sleeping.

23486.label: Matthew 8:25
23486.text: And they came and woke him up, saying: “Lord, save us, we are about to perish!”

23487.label: Matthew 8:26
23487.text: But he said to them: “Why are you so afraid, you with little faith?” Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and a great calm set in.

23488.label: Matthew 8:27
23488.text: So the men were amazed and said: “What sort of person is this? Even the winds and the sea obey him.”

23489.label: Matthew 8:28
23489.text: When he came to the other side into the region of the Gad·a·renesʹ, two demon-possessed men coming out from among the tombs met him. They were unusually fierce, so nobody had the courage to pass by on that road.

23490.label: Matthew 8:29
23490.text: And look! they screamed, saying: “What have we to do with you, Son of God? Did you come here to torment us before the appointed time?”

23491.label: Matthew 8:30
23491.text: A long way off from them, a herd of many swine was feeding.

23492.label: Matthew 8:31
23492.text: So the demons began to plead with him, saying: “If you expel us, send us into the herd of swine.”

23493.label: Matthew 8:32
23493.text: And he said to them: “Go!” With that they came out and went off into the swine, and look! the entire herd rushed over the precipice into the sea and died in the waters.

23494.label: Matthew 8:33
23494.text: But the herders fled, and going into the city, they reported everything, including the account of the demon-possessed men.

23495.label: Matthew 8:34
23495.text: And look! all the city turned out to meet Jesus, and when they saw him, they urged him to depart from their region.

23496.label: Matthew 9:1
23496.text: So boarding the boat, he traveled across and went into his own city.

23497.label: Matthew 9:2
23497.text: And look! they were bringing him a paralyzed man lying on a stretcher. On seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralytic: “Take courage, child! Your sins are forgiven.”

23498.label: Matthew 9:3
23498.text: Now certain scribes said to themselves: “This fellow is blaspheming.”

23499.label: Matthew 9:4
23499.text: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said: “Why are you thinking wicked things in your hearts?

23500.label: Matthew 9:5
23500.text: For instance, which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

23501.label: Matthew 9:6
23501.text: However, in order for you to know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” then he said to the paralytic: “Get up, pick up your stretcher, and go to your home.”

23502.label: Matthew 9:7
23502.text: And he got up and went to his home.

23503.label: Matthew 9:8
23503.text: When the crowds saw this, they were struck with fear, and they glorified God, who gave such authority to men.

23504.label: Matthew 9:9
23504.text: Next, while moving on from there, Jesus caught sight of a man named Matthew sitting at the tax office, and he said to him: “Be my follower.” At that he rose up and followed him.

23505.label: Matthew 9:10
23505.text: Later as he was dining in the house, look! many tax collectors and sinners came and began dining with Jesus and his disciples.

23506.label: Matthew 9:11
23506.text: But on seeing this, the Pharisees said to his disciples: “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

23507.label: Matthew 9:12
23507.text: Hearing them, he said: “Healthy people do not need a physician, but those who are ill do.

23508.label: Matthew 9:13
23508.text: Go, then, and learn what this means: ‘I want mercy, and not sacrifice.’ For I came to call, not righteous people, but sinners.”

23509.label: Matthew 9:14
23509.text: Then John’s disciples came to him and asked: “Why do we and the Pharisees practice fasting but your disciples do not fast?”

23510.label: Matthew 9:15
23510.text: At this Jesus said to them: “The friends of the bridegroom have no reason to mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them, do they? But days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

23511.label: Matthew 9:16
23511.text: Nobody sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old outer garment, for the new piece pulls away from the garment and the tear becomes worse.

23512.label: Matthew 9:17
23512.text: Nor do people put new wine into old wineskins. If they do, then the wineskins burst and the wine spills out and the wineskins are ruined. But people put new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”

23513.label: Matthew 9:18
23513.text: While he was telling them these things, look! a certain ruler who had approached did obeisance to him, saying: “By now my daughter must be dead, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will come to life.”

23514.label: Matthew 9:19
23514.text: Then Jesus got up and, with his disciples, followed him.

23515.label: Matthew 9:20
23515.text: And look! a woman suffering for 12 years from a flow of blood approached from behind and touched the fringe of his outer garment,

23516.label: Matthew 9:21
23516.text: for she kept saying to herself: “If I only touch his outer garment, I will get well.”

23517.label: Matthew 9:22
23517.text: Jesus turned around and, noticing her, said: “Take courage, daughter! Your faith has made you well.” And from that hour the woman was made well.

23518.label: Matthew 9:23
23518.text: When, now, he came into the ruler’s house and caught sight of the flute players and the crowd making a commotion,

23519.label: Matthew 9:24
23519.text: Jesus said: “Leave the place, for the little girl did not die but is sleeping.” At this they began to laugh at him scornfully.

23520.label: Matthew 9:25
23520.text: As soon as the crowd had been sent outside, he went in and took hold of her hand, and the little girl got up.

23521.label: Matthew 9:26
23521.text: Of course, the talk about this spread into all that region.

23522.label: Matthew 9:27
23522.text: As Jesus moved on from there, two blind men followed him, shouting out: “Have mercy on us, Son of David.”

23523.label: Matthew 9:28
23523.text: After he had gone into the house, the blind men came to him, and Jesus asked them: “Do you have faith that I can do this?” They answered him: “Yes, Lord.”

23524.label: Matthew 9:29
23524.text: Then he touched their eyes, saying: “According to your faith let it happen to you.”

23525.label: Matthew 9:30
23525.text: And their eyes received sight. Moreover, Jesus sternly warned them, saying: “See that nobody gets to know it.”

23526.label: Matthew 9:31
23526.text: But after going outside, they made it public about him in all that region.

23527.label: Matthew 9:32
23527.text: When they were leaving, look! people brought him a speechless man possessed of a demon;

23528.label: Matthew 9:33
23528.text: and after the demon had been expelled, the speechless man spoke. Well, the crowds were amazed and said: “Never has anything like this been seen in Israel.”

23529.label: Matthew 9:34
23529.text: But the Pharisees were saying: “It is by the ruler of the demons that he expels the demons.”

23530.label: Matthew 9:35
23530.text: And Jesus set out on a tour of all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news of the Kingdom and curing every sort of disease and every sort of infirmity.

23531.label: Matthew 9:36
23531.text: On seeing the crowds, he felt pity for them, because they were skinned and thrown about like sheep without a shepherd.

23532.label: Matthew 9:37
23532.text: Then he said to his disciples: “Yes, the harvest is great, but the workers are few.

23533.label: Matthew 9:38
23533.text: Therefore, beg the Master of the harvest to send out workers into his harvest.”

23534.label: Matthew 10:1
23534.text: So he summoned his 12 disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits, in order to expel these and to cure every sort of disease and every sort of infirmity.

23535.label: Matthew 10:2
23535.text: The names of the 12 apostles are these: First, Simon, the one called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebʹe·dee and John his brother;

23536.label: Matthew 10:3
23536.text: Philip and Bar·tholʹo·mew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Al·phaeʹus; and Thad·daeʹus;

23537.label: Matthew 10:4
23537.text: Simon the Ca·na·naeʹan; and Judas Is·carʹi·ot, who later betrayed him.

23538.label: Matthew 10:5
23538.text: These 12 Jesus sent out, giving them these instructions: “Do not go off into the road of the nations, and do not enter any Sa·marʹi·tan city;

23539.label: Matthew 10:6
23539.text: but instead, go continually to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

23540.label: Matthew 10:7
23540.text: As you go, preach, saying: ‘The Kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.’

23541.label: Matthew 10:8
23541.text: Cure the sick, raise up the dead, make lepers clean, expel demons. You received free, give free.

23542.label: Matthew 10:9
23542.text: Do not acquire gold or silver or copper for your money belts,

23543.label: Matthew 10:10
23543.text: or a food pouch for the trip, or two garments, or sandals, or a staff, for the worker deserves his food.

23544.label: Matthew 10:11
23544.text: “Into whatever city or village you enter, search out who in it is deserving, and stay there until you leave.

23545.label: Matthew 10:12
23545.text: When you enter the house, greet the household.

23546.label: Matthew 10:13
23546.text: If the house is deserving, let the peace you wish it come upon it; but if it is not deserving, let the peace from you return upon you.

23547.label: Matthew 10:14
23547.text: Wherever anyone does not receive you or listen to your words, on going out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

23548.label: Matthew 10:15
23548.text: Truly I say to you, it will be more endurable for the land of Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah on Judgment Day than for that city.

23549.label: Matthew 10:16
23549.text: “Look! I am sending you out as sheep among wolves; so prove yourselves cautious as serpents and yet innocent as doves.

23550.label: Matthew 10:17
23550.text: Be on your guard against men, for they will hand you over to local courts and they will scourge you in their synagogues.

23551.label: Matthew 10:18
23551.text: And you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a witness to them and the nations.

23552.label: Matthew 10:19
23552.text: However, when they hand you over, do not become anxious about how or what you are to speak, for what you are to speak will be given you in that hour;

23553.label: Matthew 10:20
23553.text: for the ones speaking are not just you, but it is the spirit of your Father that speaks by you.

23554.label: Matthew 10:21
23554.text: Further, brother will hand brother over to death, and a father his child, and children will rise up against parents and will have them put to death.

23555.label: Matthew 10:22
23555.text: And you will be hated by all people on account of my name, but the one who has endured to the end will be saved.

23556.label: Matthew 10:23
23556.text: When they persecute you in one city, flee to another; for truly I say to you, you will by no means complete the circuit of the cities of Israel until the Son of man arrives.

23557.label: Matthew 10:24
23557.text: “A student is not above his teacher, nor a slave above his master.

23558.label: Matthew 10:25
23558.text: It is enough for the student to become as his teacher, and the slave as his master. If people have called the master of the house Be·elʹze·bub, how much more those of his household?

23559.label: Matthew 10:26
23559.text: So do not fear them, for there is nothing covered over that will not become uncovered, and nothing secret that will not become known.

23560.label: Matthew 10:27
23560.text: What I tell you in the darkness, say in the light, and what you hear whispered, preach from the housetops.

23561.label: Matthew 10:28
23561.text: And do not become fearful of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather, fear him who can destroy both soul and body in Ge·henʹna.

23562.label: Matthew 10:29
23562.text: Two sparrows sell for a coin of small value, do they not? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father’s knowledge.

23563.label: Matthew 10:30
23563.text: But even the hairs of your head are all numbered.

23564.label: Matthew 10:31
23564.text: So have no fear; you are worth more than many sparrows.

23565.label: Matthew 10:32
23565.text: “Everyone, then, who acknowledges me before men, I will also acknowledge him before my Father who is in the heavens.

23566.label: Matthew 10:33
23566.text: But whoever disowns me before men, I will also disown him before my Father who is in the heavens.

23567.label: Matthew 10:34
23567.text: Do not think I came to bring peace to the earth; I came to bring, not peace, but a sword.

23568.label: Matthew 10:35
23568.text: For I came to cause division, with a man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

23569.label: Matthew 10:36
23569.text: Indeed, a man’s enemies will be those of his own household.

23570.label: Matthew 10:37
23570.text: Whoever has greater affection for father or mother than for me is not worthy of me; and whoever has greater affection for son or daughter than for me is not worthy of me.

23571.label: Matthew 10:38
23571.text: And whoever does not accept his torture stake and follow after me is not worthy of me.

23572.label: Matthew 10:39
23572.text: Whoever finds his soul will lose it, and whoever loses his soul for my sake will find it.

23573.label: Matthew 10:40
23573.text: “Whoever receives you receives me also, and whoever receives me receives also the One who sent me.

23574.label: Matthew 10:41
23574.text: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will get a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will get a righteous man’s reward.

23575.label: Matthew 10:42
23575.text: And whoever gives one of these little ones only a cup of cold water to drink because he is a disciple, I tell you truly, he will by no means lose his reward.”

23576.label: Matthew 11:1
23576.text: When Jesus had finished giving instructions to his 12 disciples, he set out from there to teach and preach in their cities.

23577.label: Matthew 11:2
23577.text: But John, having heard in jail about the works of the Christ, sent his disciples

23578.label: Matthew 11:3
23578.text: to ask him: “Are you the Coming One, or are we to expect a different one?”

23579.label: Matthew 11:4
23579.text: In reply Jesus said to them: “Go and report to John what you are hearing and seeing:

23580.label: Matthew 11:5
23580.text: The blind are now seeing and the lame are walking, the lepers are being cleansed and the deaf are hearing, the dead are being raised up and the poor are being told the good news.

23581.label: Matthew 11:6
23581.text: Happy is the one who finds no cause for stumbling in me.”

23582.label: Matthew 11:7
23582.text: While these were on their way, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed being tossed by the wind?

23583.label: Matthew 11:8
23583.text: What, then, did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft garments? Why, those wearing soft garments are in the houses of kings.

23584.label: Matthew 11:9
23584.text: Really, then, why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and far more than a prophet.

23585.label: Matthew 11:10
23585.text: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Look! I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way ahead of you!’

23586.label: Matthew 11:11
23586.text: Truly I say to you, among those born of women, there has not been raised up anyone greater than John the Baptist, but a lesser person in the Kingdom of the heavens is greater than he is.

23587.label: Matthew 11:12
23587.text: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the Kingdom of the heavens is the goal toward which men press, and those pressing forward are seizing it.

23588.label: Matthew 11:13
23588.text: For all, the Prophets and the Law, prophesied until John;

23589.label: Matthew 11:14
23589.text: and if you are willing to accept it, he is ‘E·liʹjah who is to come.’

23590.label: Matthew 11:15
23590.text: Let the one who has ears listen.

23591.label: Matthew 11:16
23591.text: “With whom will I compare this generation? It is like young children sitting in the marketplaces who call out to their playmates,

23592.label: Matthew 11:17
23592.text: saying: ‘We played the flute for you, but you did not dance; we wailed, but you did not beat yourselves in grief.’

23593.label: Matthew 11:18
23593.text: Likewise, John came neither eating nor drinking, but people say, ‘He has a demon.’

23594.label: Matthew 11:19
23594.text: The Son of man did come eating and drinking, but people say, ‘Look! A man who is a glutton and is given to drinking wine, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’ All the same, wisdom is proved righteous by its works.”

23595.label: Matthew 11:20
23595.text: Then he began to reproach the cities in which most of his powerful works had taken place, for they did not repent:

23596.label: Matthew 11:21
23596.text: “Woe to you, Cho·raʹzin! Woe to you, Beth·saʹi·da! because if the powerful works that took place in you had taken place in Tyre and Siʹdon, they would long ago have repented in sackcloth and ashes.

23597.label: Matthew 11:22
23597.text: But I say to you, it will be more endurable for Tyre and Siʹdon on Judgment Day than for you.

23598.label: Matthew 11:23
23598.text: And you, Ca·perʹna·um, will you perhaps be exalted to heaven? Down to the Grave you will come; because if the powerful works that took place in you had taken place in Sodʹom, it would have remained until this very day.

23599.label: Matthew 11:24
23599.text: But I say to you, it will be more endurable for the land of Sodʹom on Judgment Day than for you.”

23600.label: Matthew 11:25
23600.text: At that time Jesus said in response: “I publicly praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and intellectual ones and have revealed them to young children.

23601.label: Matthew 11:26
23601.text: Yes, O Father, because this is the way you approved.

23602.label: Matthew 11:27
23602.text: All things have been handed over to me by my Father, and no one fully knows the Son except the Father; neither does anyone fully know the Father except the Son and anyone to whom the Son is willing to reveal him.

23603.label: Matthew 11:28
23603.text: Come to me, all you who are toiling and loaded down, and I will refresh you.

23604.label: Matthew 11:29
23604.text: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am mild-tempered and lowly in heart, and you will find refreshment for yourselves.

23605.label: Matthew 11:30
23605.text: For my yoke is kindly, and my load is light.”

23606.label: Matthew 12:1
23606.text: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples got hungry and started to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

23607.label: Matthew 12:2
23607.text: At seeing this, the Pharisees said to him: “Look! Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

23608.label: Matthew 12:3
23608.text: He said to them: “Have you not read what David did when he and the men with him were hungry?

23609.label: Matthew 12:4
23609.text: How he entered into the house of God and they ate the loaves of presentation, something that it was not lawful for him or those with him to eat, but for the priests only?

23610.label: Matthew 12:5
23610.text: Or have you not read in the Law that on the Sabbaths the priests in the temple violate the Sabbath and continue guiltless?

23611.label: Matthew 12:6
23611.text: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.

23612.label: Matthew 12:7
23612.text: However, if you had understood what this means, ‘I want mercy and not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the guiltless ones.

23613.label: Matthew 12:8
23613.text: For the Son of man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

23614.label: Matthew 12:9
23614.text: After departing from that place, he went into their synagogue,

23615.label: Matthew 12:10
23615.text: and look! there was a man with a withered hand! So they asked him, “Is it lawful to cure on the Sabbath?” so that they might accuse him.

23616.label: Matthew 12:11
23616.text: He said to them: “If you have one sheep and that sheep falls into a pit on the Sabbath, is there a man among you who will not grab hold of it and lift it out?

23617.label: Matthew 12:12
23617.text: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! So it is lawful to do a fine thing on the Sabbath.”

23618.label: Matthew 12:13
23618.text: Then he said to the man: “Stretch out your hand.” And he stretched it out, and it was restored sound like the other hand.

23619.label: Matthew 12:14
23619.text: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him to kill him.

23620.label: Matthew 12:15
23620.text: Having come to know this, Jesus departed from there. Many also followed him, and he cured them all,

23621.label: Matthew 12:16
23621.text: but he sternly ordered them not to make him known,

23622.label: Matthew 12:17
23622.text: in order to fulfill what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, who said:

23623.label: Matthew 12:18
23623.text: “Look! My servant whom I chose, my beloved, whom I have approved! I will put my spirit upon him, and what justice is he will make clear to the nations.

23624.label: Matthew 12:19
23624.text: He will not quarrel nor cry aloud, nor will anyone hear his voice in the main streets.

23625.label: Matthew 12:20
23625.text: No bruised reed will he crush, and no smoldering wick will he extinguish, until he brings justice with success.

23626.label: Matthew 12:21
23626.text: Indeed, in his name nations will hope.”

23627.label: Matthew 12:22
23627.text: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and speechless, and he cured him, so that the speechless man could speak and see.

23628.label: Matthew 12:23
23628.text: Well, all the crowds were astounded and began to say: “May this not perhaps be the Son of David?”

23629.label: Matthew 12:24
23629.text: At hearing this, the Pharisees said: “This fellow does not expel the demons except by means of Be·elʹze·bub, the ruler of the demons.”

23630.label: Matthew 12:25
23630.text: Knowing their thoughts, he said to them: “Every kingdom divided against itself comes to ruin, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

23631.label: Matthew 12:26
23631.text: In the same way, if Satan expels Satan, he has become divided against himself; how, then, will his kingdom stand?

23632.label: Matthew 12:27
23632.text: Moreover, if I expel the demons by means of Be·elʹze·bub, by whom do your sons expel them? This is why they will be your judges.

23633.label: Matthew 12:28
23633.text: But if it is by means of God’s spirit that I expel the demons, the Kingdom of God has really overtaken you.

23634.label: Matthew 12:29
23634.text: Or how can anyone invade the house of a strong man and seize his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Only then can he plunder his house.

23635.label: Matthew 12:30
23635.text: Whoever is not on my side is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.

23636.label: Matthew 12:31
23636.text: “For this reason I say to you, every sort of sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the spirit will not be forgiven.

23637.label: Matthew 12:32
23637.text: For example, whoever speaks a word against the Son of man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the holy spirit, it will not be forgiven him, no, not in this system of things nor in that to come.

23638.label: Matthew 12:33
23638.text: “Either you make the tree fine and its fruit fine or make the tree rotten and its fruit rotten, for by its fruit the tree is known.

23639.label: Matthew 12:34
23639.text: Offspring of vipers, how can you speak good things when you are wicked? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

23640.label: Matthew 12:35
23640.text: The good man out of his good treasure sends out good things, whereas the wicked man out of his wicked treasure sends out wicked things.

23641.label: Matthew 12:36
23641.text: I tell you that men will render an account on Judgment Day for every unprofitable saying that they speak;

23642.label: Matthew 12:37
23642.text: for by your words you will be declared righteous, and by your words you will be condemned.”

23643.label: Matthew 12:38
23643.text: Then as an answer to him, some of the scribes and the Pharisees said: “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

23644.label: Matthew 12:39
23644.text: In reply he said to them: “A wicked and adulterous generation keeps on seeking a sign, but no sign will be given it except the sign of Joʹnah the prophet.

23645.label: Matthew 12:40
23645.text: For just as Joʹnah was in the belly of the huge fish for three days and three nights, so the Son of man will be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.

23646.label: Matthew 12:41
23646.text: Men of Ninʹe·veh will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, because they repented at what Joʹnah preached. But look! something more than Joʹnah is here.

23647.label: Matthew 12:42
23647.text: The queen of the south will be raised up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solʹo·mon. But look! something more than Solʹo·mon is here.

23648.label: Matthew 12:43
23648.text: “When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through waterless places in search of a resting-place and finds none.

23649.label: Matthew 12:44
23649.text: Then it says, ‘I will go back to my house from which I moved,’ and on arriving, it finds the house unoccupied but swept clean and adorned.

23650.label: Matthew 12:45
23650.text: Then it goes and takes along with it seven different spirits more wicked than itself, and after getting inside, they dwell there; and the final circumstances of that man become worse than the first. That is how it will be also with this wicked generation.”

23651.label: Matthew 12:46
23651.text: While he was yet speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers were standing outside, seeking to speak to him.

23652.label: Matthew 12:47
23652.text: So someone said to him: “Look! Your mother and your brothers are standing outside, seeking to speak to you.”

23653.label: Matthew 12:48
23653.text: In reply he said to the one who spoke to him: “Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?”

23654.label: Matthew 12:49
23654.text: And extending his hand toward his disciples, he said: “Look! My mother and my brothers!

23655.label: Matthew 12:50
23655.text: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, that one is my brother and sister and mother.”

23656.label: Matthew 13:1
23656.text: On that day Jesus left the house and was sitting by the sea.

23657.label: Matthew 13:2
23657.text: And such large crowds gathered to him that he went aboard a boat and sat down, and all the crowd was standing on the beach.

23658.label: Matthew 13:3
23658.text: Then he told them many things by illustrations, saying: “Look! A sower went out to sow.

23659.label: Matthew 13:4
23659.text: As he was sowing, some seeds fell alongside the road, and the birds came and ate them up.

23660.label: Matthew 13:5
23660.text: Others fell on rocky ground where there was not much soil, and they immediately sprang up because the soil was not deep.

23661.label: Matthew 13:6
23661.text: But when the sun rose, they were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

23662.label: Matthew 13:7
23662.text: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked them.

23663.label: Matthew 13:8
23663.text: Still others fell on the fine soil, and they began to yield fruit, this one 100 times more, that one 60, the other 30.

23664.label: Matthew 13:9
23664.text: Let the one who has ears listen.”

23665.label: Matthew 13:10
23665.text: So the disciples came and said to him: “Why do you speak to them by the use of illustrations?”

23666.label: Matthew 13:11
23666.text: In reply he said: “To you it is granted to understand the sacred secrets of the Kingdom of the heavens, but to them it is not granted.

23667.label: Matthew 13:12
23667.text: For whoever has, more will be given him, and he will be made to abound; but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.

23668.label: Matthew 13:13
23668.text: That is why I speak to them by the use of illustrations; for looking, they look in vain, and hearing, they hear in vain, nor do they get the sense of it.

23669.label: Matthew 13:14
23669.text: And the prophecy of Isaiah is being fulfilled in their case. It says: ‘You will indeed hear but by no means get the sense of it, and you will indeed look but by no means see.

23670.label: Matthew 13:15
23670.text: For the heart of this people has grown unreceptive, and with their ears they have heard without response, and they have shut their eyes, so that they might never see with their eyes and hear with their ears and get the sense of it with their hearts and turn back and I heal them.’

23671.label: Matthew 13:16
23671.text: “However, happy are your eyes because they see and your ears because they hear.

23672.label: Matthew 13:17
23672.text: For truly I say to you, many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things you are observing but did not see them, and to hear the things you are hearing but did not hear them.

23673.label: Matthew 13:18
23673.text: “Now listen to the illustration of the man who sowed.

23674.label: Matthew 13:19
23674.text: Where anyone hears the word of the Kingdom but does not get the sense of it, the wicked one comes and snatches away what has been sown in his heart; this is the one sown alongside the road.

23675.label: Matthew 13:20
23675.text: As for the one sown on rocky ground, this is the one hearing the word and at once accepting it with joy.

23676.label: Matthew 13:21
23676.text: Yet, he has no root in himself but continues for a time, and after tribulation or persecution has arisen on account of the word, he is at once stumbled.

23677.label: Matthew 13:22
23677.text: As for the one sown among the thorns, this is the one hearing the word, but the anxiety of this system of things and the deceptive power of riches choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

23678.label: Matthew 13:23
23678.text: As for the one sown upon the fine soil, this is the one hearing the word and getting the sense of it, who really does bear fruit and produces, this one 100 times more, that one 60, the other 30.”

23679.label: Matthew 13:24
23679.text: He presented another illustration to them, saying: “The Kingdom of the heavens may be likened to a man who sowed fine seed in his field.

23680.label: Matthew 13:25
23680.text: While men were sleeping, his enemy came and oversowed weeds in among the wheat and left.

23681.label: Matthew 13:26
23681.text: When the stalk sprouted and produced fruit, then the weeds also appeared.

23682.label: Matthew 13:27
23682.text: So the slaves of the master of the house came and said to him, ‘Master, did you not sow fine seed in your field? How, then, does it have weeds?’

23683.label: Matthew 13:28
23683.text: He said to them, ‘An enemy, a man, did this.’ The slaves said to him, ‘Do you want us, then, to go out and collect them?’

23684.label: Matthew 13:29
23684.text: He said, ‘No, for fear that while collecting the weeds, you uproot the wheat with them.

23685.label: Matthew 13:30
23685.text: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest season, I will tell the reapers: First collect the weeds and bind them in bundles to burn them up; then gather the wheat into my storehouse.’”

23686.label: Matthew 13:31
23686.text: He presented another illustration to them, saying: “The Kingdom of the heavens is like a mustard grain that a man took and planted in his field.

23687.label: Matthew 13:32
23687.text: It is, in fact, the tiniest of all the seeds, but when it has grown, it is the largest of the vegetable plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of heaven come and find lodging among its branches.”

23688.label: Matthew 13:33
23688.text: He told them another illustration: “The Kingdom of the heavens is like leaven that a woman took and mixed with three large measures of flour until the whole mass was fermented.”

23689.label: Matthew 13:34
23689.text: All these things Jesus spoke to the crowds by illustrations. Indeed, without an illustration he would not speak to them,

23690.label: Matthew 13:35
23690.text: in order to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet who said: “I will open my mouth with illustrations; I will proclaim things hidden since the founding.”

23691.label: Matthew 13:36
23691.text: Then after dismissing the crowds, he went into the house. His disciples came to him and said: “Explain to us the illustration of the weeds in the field.”

23692.label: Matthew 13:37
23692.text: In response he said: “The sower of the fine seed is the Son of man;

23693.label: Matthew 13:38
23693.text: the field is the world. As for the fine seed, these are the sons of the Kingdom, but the weeds are the sons of the wicked one,

23694.label: Matthew 13:39
23694.text: and the enemy who sowed them is the Devil. The harvest is a conclusion of a system of things, and the reapers are angels.

23695.label: Matthew 13:40
23695.text: Therefore, just as the weeds are collected and burned with fire, so it will be in the conclusion of the system of things.

23696.label: Matthew 13:41
23696.text: The Son of man will send his angels, and they will collect out from his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and people who practice lawlessness,

23697.label: Matthew 13:42
23697.text: and they will pitch them into the fiery furnace. There is where their weeping and the gnashing of their teeth will be.

23698.label: Matthew 13:43
23698.text: At that time the righteous ones will shine as brightly as the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. Let the one who has ears listen.

23699.label: Matthew 13:44
23699.text: “The Kingdom of the heavens is like a treasure, hidden in the field, that a man found and hid; and because of his joy, he goes and sells everything he has and buys that field.

23700.label: Matthew 13:45
23700.text: “Again the Kingdom of the heavens is like a traveling merchant seeking fine pearls.

23701.label: Matthew 13:46
23701.text: Upon finding one pearl of high value, he went away and promptly sold all the things he had and bought it.

23702.label: Matthew 13:47
23702.text: “Again the Kingdom of the heavens is like a dragnet let down into the sea and gathering fish of every kind.

23703.label: Matthew 13:48
23703.text: When it was full, they hauled it up onto the beach, and sitting down, they collected the fine ones into containers, but the unsuitable they threw away.

23704.label: Matthew 13:49
23704.text: That is how it will be in the conclusion of the system of things. The angels will go out and separate the wicked from among the righteous

23705.label: Matthew 13:50
23705.text: and will cast them into the fiery furnace. There is where their weeping and the gnashing of their teeth will be.

23706.label: Matthew 13:51
23706.text: “Did you get the sense of all these things?” They said to him: “Yes.”

23707.label: Matthew 13:52
23707.text: Then he said to them: “That being the case, every public instructor who is taught about the Kingdom of the heavens is like a man, the master of the house, who brings out of his treasure store things both new and old.”

23708.label: Matthew 13:53
23708.text: When Jesus had finished these illustrations, he departed from there.

23709.label: Matthew 13:54
23709.text: After coming into his home territory, he began to teach them in their synagogue, so that they were astounded and said: “Where did this man get this wisdom and these powerful works?

23710.label: Matthew 13:55
23710.text: Is this not the carpenter’s son? Is not his mother called Mary, and his brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?

23711.label: Matthew 13:56
23711.text: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Where, then, did he get all of this?”

23712.label: Matthew 13:57
23712.text: So they began to stumble because of him. But Jesus said to them: “A prophet is not without honor except in his home territory and in his own house.”

23713.label: Matthew 13:58
23713.text: And he did not perform many powerful works there on account of their lack of faith.

23714.label: Matthew 14:1
23714.text: At that time Herod, the district ruler, heard the report about Jesus

23715.label: Matthew 14:2
23715.text: and said to his servants: “This is John the Baptist. He was raised up from the dead, and this is why these powerful works are operating in him.”

23716.label: Matthew 14:3
23716.text: Herod had arrested John and had bound him and imprisoned him because of He·roʹdi·as, the wife of Philip his brother.

23717.label: Matthew 14:4
23717.text: For John had been saying to him: “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

23718.label: Matthew 14:5
23718.text: However, although he wanted to kill him, he feared the crowd, because they took him for a prophet.

23719.label: Matthew 14:6
23719.text: But when Herod’s birthday was being celebrated, the daughter of He·roʹdi·as danced for the occasion and pleased Herod so much

23720.label: Matthew 14:7
23720.text: that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.

23721.label: Matthew 14:8
23721.text: Then she, at her mother’s prompting, said: “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”

23722.label: Matthew 14:9
23722.text: Grieved though he was, the king, out of regard for his oaths and for those dining with him, commanded it to be given.

23723.label: Matthew 14:10
23723.text: So he sent and had John beheaded in the prison.

23724.label: Matthew 14:11
23724.text: His head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.

23725.label: Matthew 14:12
23725.text: Later his disciples came and removed his corpse and buried him; then they came and reported to Jesus.

23726.label: Matthew 14:13
23726.text: At hearing this, Jesus departed from there by boat into an isolated place to be alone. But the crowds, getting to hear of it, followed him on foot from the cities.

23727.label: Matthew 14:14
23727.text: When he came ashore, he saw a large crowd, and he felt pity for them, and he cured their sick ones.

23728.label: Matthew 14:15
23728.text: But when evening fell, his disciples came to him and said: “The place is isolated and the hour is already late; send the crowds away, so that they may go into the villages and buy themselves food.”

23729.label: Matthew 14:16
23729.text: However, Jesus said to them: “They do not have to leave; you give them something to eat.”

23730.label: Matthew 14:17
23730.text: They said to him: “We have nothing here except five loaves and two fish.”

23731.label: Matthew 14:18
23731.text: He said: “Bring them here to me.”

23732.label: Matthew 14:19
23732.text: And he instructed the crowds to recline on the grass. Then he took the five loaves and two fish, and looking up to heaven, he said a blessing, and after breaking the loaves, he gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.

23733.label: Matthew 14:20
23733.text: So they all ate and were satisfied, and they took up the leftover fragments, 12 baskets full.

23734.label: Matthew 14:21
23734.text: Now those eating were about 5,000 men, as well as women and young children.

23735.label: Matthew 14:22
23735.text: Then, without delay, he made his disciples board the boat and go ahead of him to the opposite shore, while he sent the crowds away.

23736.label: Matthew 14:23
23736.text: After sending the crowds away, he went up on the mountain by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone.

23737.label: Matthew 14:24
23737.text: By now the boat was many hundreds of yards away from land, struggling against the waves because the wind was against them.

23738.label: Matthew 14:25
23738.text: But in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea.

23739.label: Matthew 14:26
23739.text: When they caught sight of him walking on the sea, the disciples were troubled, saying: “It is an apparition!” And they cried out in their fear.

23740.label: Matthew 14:27
23740.text: But at once Jesus spoke to them, saying: “Take courage! It is I; do not be afraid.”

23741.label: Matthew 14:28
23741.text: Peter answered him: “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you over the waters.”

23742.label: Matthew 14:29
23742.text: He said: “Come!” So Peter got out of the boat and walked over the waters and went toward Jesus.

23743.label: Matthew 14:30
23743.text: But looking at the windstorm, he became afraid. And when he started to sink, he cried out: “Lord, save me!”

23744.label: Matthew 14:31
23744.text: Immediately stretching out his hand, Jesus caught hold of him and said to him: “You with little faith, why did you give way to doubt?”

23745.label: Matthew 14:32
23745.text: After they got up into the boat, the windstorm abated.

23746.label: Matthew 14:33
23746.text: Then those in the boat did obeisance to him, saying: “You really are God’s Son.”

23747.label: Matthew 14:34
23747.text: And they crossed over and came to land in Gen·nesʹa·ret.

23748.label: Matthew 14:35
23748.text: On recognizing him, the men of that place sent word into all that surrounding country, and people brought him all those who were ill.

23749.label: Matthew 14:36
23749.text: And they pleaded with him that they might just touch the fringe of his outer garment, and all those who touched it were made completely well.

23750.label: Matthew 15:1
23750.text: Then there came to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying:

23751.label: Matthew 15:2
23751.text: “Why do your disciples overstep the tradition of the men of former times? For example, they do not wash their hands when about to eat a meal.”

23752.label: Matthew 15:3
23752.text: In reply he said to them: “Why do you overstep the commandment of God because of your tradition?

23753.label: Matthew 15:4
23753.text: For example, God said, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘Let the one who speaks abusively of his father or mother be put to death.’

23754.label: Matthew 15:5
23754.text: But you say, ‘Whoever says to his father or mother: “Whatever I have that could benefit you is a gift dedicated to God,”

23755.label: Matthew 15:6
23755.text: he need not honor his father at all.’ So you have made the word of God invalid because of your tradition.

23756.label: Matthew 15:7
23756.text: You hypocrites, Isaiah aptly prophesied about you when he said:

23757.label: Matthew 15:8
23757.text: ‘This people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far removed from me.

23758.label: Matthew 15:9
23758.text: It is in vain that they keep worshipping me, for they teach commands of men as doctrines.’”

23759.label: Matthew 15:10
23759.text: With that he called the crowd near and said to them: “Listen and get the sense of it:

23760.label: Matthew 15:11
23760.text: It is not what enters into a man’s mouth that defiles him, but it is what comes out of his mouth that defiles him.”

23761.label: Matthew 15:12
23761.text: Then the disciples came and said to him: “Do you know that the Pharisees were stumbled at hearing what you said?”
