24275.text: And they spat on him and took the reed and began hitting him on his head.

24276.label: Matthew 27:31
24276.text: Finally, after they had mocked him, they stripped him of the cloak and put his outer garments on him and led him off to be nailed to the stake.

24277.label: Matthew 27:32
24277.text: As they were going out, they found a man of Cy·reʹne named Simon. This man they compelled into service to carry his torture stake.

24278.label: Matthew 27:33
24278.text: And when they came to a place called Golʹgo·tha, that is, Skull Place,

24279.label: Matthew 27:34
24279.text: they gave him wine mixed with gall to drink; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.

24280.label: Matthew 27:35
24280.text: When they had nailed him to the stake, they distributed his outer garments by casting lots,

24281.label: Matthew 27:36
24281.text: and they sat there keeping watch over him.

24282.label: Matthew 27:37
24282.text: They also posted above his head the charge against him, in writing: “This is Jesus the King of the Jews.”

24283.label: Matthew 27:38
24283.text: Then two robbers were put on stakes alongside him, one on his right and one on his left.

24284.label: Matthew 27:39
24284.text: And those passing by spoke abusively of him, shaking their heads

24285.label: Matthew 27:40
24285.text: and saying: “You who would throw down the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are a son of God, come down off the torture stake!”

24286.label: Matthew 27:41
24286.text: In the same way also, the chief priests with the scribes and the elders began mocking him, saying:

24287.label: Matthew 27:42
24287.text: “Others he saved; himself he cannot save! He is King of Israel; let him now come down off the torture stake, and we will believe in him.

24288.label: Matthew 27:43
24288.text: He has put his trust in God; let Him now rescue him if He wants him, for he said, ‘I am God’s Son.’”

24289.label: Matthew 27:44
24289.text: In the same way, even the robbers who were on stakes alongside him were reproaching him.

24290.label: Matthew 27:45
24290.text: From the sixth hour on, a darkness fell over all the land until the ninth hour.

24291.label: Matthew 27:46
24291.text: About the ninth hour, Jesus called out with a loud voice, saying: “Eʹli, Eʹli, laʹma sa·bach·thaʹni?” that is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

24292.label: Matthew 27:47
24292.text: At hearing this, some of those standing there began to say: “This man is calling E·liʹjah.”

24293.label: Matthew 27:48
24293.text: And immediately one of them ran and took a sponge and soaked it in sour wine and put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink.

24294.label: Matthew 27:49
24294.text: But the rest of them said: “Let him be! Let us see whether E·liʹjah comes to save him.”

24295.label: Matthew 27:50
24295.text: Again Jesus called out with a loud voice and yielded up his spirit.

24296.label: Matthew 27:51
24296.text: And look! the curtain of the sanctuary was torn in two, from top to bottom, and the earth quaked, and the rocks were split.

24297.label: Matthew 27:52
24297.text: And the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the holy ones who had fallen asleep were raised up

24298.label: Matthew 27:53
24298.text: (and people coming out from among the tombs after his being raised up entered into the holy city), and they became visible to many people.

24299.label: Matthew 27:54
24299.text: But when the army officer and those with him keeping watch over Jesus saw the earthquake and the things happening, they grew very much afraid and said: “Certainly this was God’s Son.”

24300.label: Matthew 27:55
24300.text: And many women were there watching from a distance, who had accompanied Jesus from Galʹi·lee to minister to him;

24301.label: Matthew 27:56
24301.text: among them were Mary Magʹda·lene and Mary the mother of James and Joʹses and the mother of the sons of Zebʹe·dee.

24302.label: Matthew 27:57
24302.text: Now as it was late in the afternoon, a rich man of Ar·i·ma·theʹa came, named Joseph, who had also become a disciple of Jesus.

24303.label: Matthew 27:58
24303.text: This man approached Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded that it be given to him.

24304.label: Matthew 27:59
24304.text: Joseph took the body, wrapped it up in clean, fine linen,

24305.label: Matthew 27:60
24305.text: and laid it in his new tomb, which he had quarried in the rock. And after rolling a big stone to the entrance of the tomb, he left.

24306.label: Matthew 27:61
24306.text: But Mary Magʹda·lene and the other Mary continued there, sitting before the grave.

24307.label: Matthew 27:62
24307.text: The next day, which was after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered together before Pilate,

24308.label: Matthew 27:63
24308.text: saying: “Sir, we recall what that impostor said while he was still alive, ‘After three days I am to be raised up.’

24309.label: Matthew 27:64
24309.text: Therefore, command that the grave be made secure until the third day, so that his disciples may not come and steal him and say to the people, ‘He was raised up from the dead!’ Then this last deception will be worse than the first.”

24310.label: Matthew 27:65
24310.text: Pilate said to them: “You may have a guard. Go make it as secure as you know how.”

24311.label: Matthew 27:66
24311.text: So they went and made the grave secure by sealing the stone and posting a guard.

24312.label: Matthew 28:1
24312.text: After the Sabbath, when it was growing light on the first day of the week, Mary Magʹda·lene and the other Mary came to view the grave.

24313.label: Matthew 28:2
24313.text: And look! a great earthquake had taken place, for Jehovah’s angel had descended from heaven and had come and rolled away the stone, and he was sitting on it.

24314.label: Matthew 28:3
24314.text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing was as white as snow.

24315.label: Matthew 28:4
24315.text: Yes, out of their fear of him, the watchmen trembled and became as dead men.

24316.label: Matthew 28:5
24316.text: But the angel said to the women: “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus who was executed on the stake.

24317.label: Matthew 28:6
24317.text: He is not here, for he was raised up, just as he said. Come, see the place where he was lying.

24318.label: Matthew 28:7
24318.text: Then go quickly and tell his disciples that he was raised up from the dead, for look! he is going ahead of you into Galʹi·lee. You will see him there. Look! I have told you.”

24319.label: Matthew 28:8
24319.text: So, quickly leaving the memorial tomb, with fear and great joy, they ran to report to his disciples.

24320.label: Matthew 28:9
24320.text: And look! Jesus met them and said: “Good day!” They approached and took hold of his feet and did obeisance to him.

24321.label: Matthew 28:10
24321.text: Then Jesus said to them: “Have no fear! Go, report to my brothers so that they may go to Galʹi·lee, and there they will see me.”

24322.label: Matthew 28:11
24322.text: While they were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all the things that had happened.

24323.label: Matthew 28:12
24323.text: And after these had gathered with the elders and had consulted together, they gave a considerable number of silver pieces to the soldiers

24324.label: Matthew 28:13
24324.text: and said: “Say, ‘His disciples came in the night and stole him while we were sleeping.’

24325.label: Matthew 28:14
24325.text: And if this gets to the governor’s ears, we will explain the matter to him and you will not need to worry.”

24326.label: Matthew 28:15
24326.text: So they took the silver pieces and did as they were instructed, and this story has been spread abroad among the Jews up to this very day.

24327.label: Matthew 28:16
24327.text: However, the 11 disciples went to Galʹi·lee to the mountain where Jesus had arranged for them to meet.

24328.label: Matthew 28:17
24328.text: When they saw him, they did obeisance, but some doubted.

24329.label: Matthew 28:18
24329.text: Jesus approached and spoke to them, saying: “All authority has been given me in heaven and on the earth.

24330.label: Matthew 28:19
24330.text: Go, therefore, and make disciples of people of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the holy spirit,

24331.label: Matthew 28:20
24331.text: teaching them to observe all the things I have commanded you. And look! I am with you all the days until the conclusion of the system of things.”
